A custom Minecraft resource pack that updates and revamps various in-game elements, including item models, blocks, particles, and custom item textures (such as food, weapons, tools, clocks, and compasses). Designed to enhance the visual experience while maintaining core gameplay elements. The pack contains:Low shield, low fire, custom model for sword, custom model for totem, small utilities, small mace, better glint and much more.
